message.text: Verifying whether `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` contains the complete schema for a fresh SQLite install.
The complete schema for a fresh SQLite install is provided by `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`.

q10.
store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql

`store/migrator.go` documents that fresh installs apply `LATEST.sql` (`LatestSchemaFileName`) as the full current schema; SQLite’s copy lives in `store/migration/sqlite/`.
